reference_format.note: a 30 fps screen recording doubled to 60 fps: every motion sample is held 2 frames (on odd 0-based frames)

layers: group (pans as one): composer card, menu card (above, overlapping the composer top by 111.5 px), menu highlight band, rows (emoji icon + label), header (title + library + plus icons)
composer content: '@ Add context' chip (hidden under the menu until the collapse), '/' + preview/committed label, footer (paperclip, globe, 'All sources', blue send button)
cursor (screen space, NOT in the panning group)

typography.font: Inter (closest free to SF Pro); row icons = flat inline SVG glyphs (no emoji font)

cursor.sprite: macOS arrow, black core 64x104 px @1080 (frac_h 0.096), white outline ~5 px, soft drop shadow; tip = hotspot
cursor.entry: fades in 0.25 s (alpha 0→1, linear) while already moving right→left: starts 0.45 s before the first hover at +328/+38 px from the row-0 rest point, curved path (dips 8 px then rises 46 px), ~880 px/s, arrives 0.183 s after the first hover
cursor.hover_rule: row highlight + composer preview switch together 0.11 s after the cursor starts the hop into the row (no fade)
cursor.click: no press scale/flash; the click is shown only by the commit + collapse
cursor.send_hop: from 'out' (pick + 0.361 s), 0.67 s to the send button centre + (10, 11) px, ease-in then ~560 px/s, slight downward arc (y overshoots 17 px, settles)

collapse.composer_pan: group pans up 191.5 px linear in 0.267 s (720 px/s) so the composer centre lands 29.5 px below frame centre (0.0766 × composer h)
collapse.menu: shrinks about its bottom centre 1 → 0.88 linear over 0.16 s (moves with the pan), removed (no fade) at +0.145 s
collapse.camera: no camera move/zoom other than the group pan

verification.render: scratchpad pm/r1 (reference content + reference beats, neutral look)
